hypotheses.rationale: The consistent morning and evening activity patterns across all four weekdays strongly suggest a regular work schedule. The timing of activities (morning activity around 9:30-9:40, evening return around 18:00-18:40) aligns with a professional routine. The objects observed still don't provide clear evidence about specific work-from-home habits or profession.

The timing of activities shows some consistency with a student routine, though the evening pattern across all weekdays suggests more regularity than typical student schedules. The Thursday evening activity at 23:38 is later than previous days, which could align with some student patterns.

The consistent evening timing doesn't align well with the flexible routine typically associated with retired individuals. The regularity of the schedule across weekdays makes this hypothesis less likely.
